# netbox_fhrp_group (Resource)

Manages a NetBox FHRP group (`/api/ipam/fhrp-groups/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_fhrp_group" "office_gw" {
  name        = "office-gateway"
  protocol    = "vrrp3"
  group_id    = 20
  auth_type   = "plaintext"
  auth_key    = "changeme"
  description = "Office VLAN 20 gateway"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) Group Id.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol. Valid values: `vrrp2`, `vrrp3`, `carp`, `clusterxl`, `hsrp`, `glbp`, `other`.

### Optional

- `auth_key` (String) Auth Key. Defaults to an empty string.
- `auth_type` (String) Auth Type. Valid values: `plaintext`, `md5`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `name` (String) Name. Defaults to an empty string.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# netbox_fhrp_group is imported by its NetBox object ID (the number in the object's URL).
terraform import netbox_fhrp_group.example 123
```
